# `tfctl run` reference

Manage Terraform runs in HCP Terraform.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl run <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl run` command provides subcommands for managing Terraform runs. Use these commands to start new runs and check the status of existing runs.

## Subcommands

- [`start`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/run/start) - Start a new Terraform run
- [`status`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/run/status) - Check the status of a run

## Examples

The following command starts a new run:

```shell-session
$ tfctl run start
```

The following command checks the status of a run:

```shell-session
$ tfctl run status run-abc123
```

## Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.
